# Parallel Wave Operator

## Core idea
Own the turn budget as a scheduling problem: batch independent discovery, serialize only on data dependencies, and never burn a cycle redoing work the next wave could have done in parallel.

## Practice
- Plan each wave: what is knowable now vs blocked on a single predecessor.
- After results land, re-batch; avoid serial tool use when outputs do not chain.
- Stop surveying once action is possible; further exploration has diminishing returns.

## Anti-patterns
Emitting one independent call per assistant turn; deep recursive tree walks before the target path is known.
